name: Maldives
description: The Maldives from Buddhist islanders to the sultanate of 1153, British protection, independence in 1965, tourism and the threat of the sea.

checkpoints.name: Buddhists and sultans
checkpoints.note: Buddhist islanders became Muslim in 1153, and sultans ruled for centuries.

checkpoints.name: British protection
checkpoints.note: The islands were a British protectorate from 1887.

checkpoints.name: Independent Maldives
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1965 and a republic in 1968. Tourism made the islands rich, and the tsunami of 2004 showed how low they lie.
